an5.75:1.1: Pañc'ime bhikkhave yodhājīvā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ.
an5.75:1.3: Idha bhikkhave ekacco yodhājīvo rajaggaṃ yeva disvā saṃsīdati visīdati na santhambhati na sakkoti saṃgāmaṃ otarituṃ.
an5.75:1.4: Evarūpo pi bhikkhave idh' ekacco yodhājīvo hoti.
an5.75:1.5: Ayaṃ bhikkhave paṭhamo yodhājīvo santo saṃvijjamāno lokasmiṃ. 3.
an5.75:2.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave idh' ekacco yodhājīvo sahati rajaggaṃ,
an5.75:2.2: api ca kho dhajaggaṃ yeva disvā saṃsīdati visīdati na santhambhati na sakkoti saṃgāmaṃ otarituṃ.
an5.75:2.3: Evarūpo pi bhikkhave idh' ekacco yodhājīvo hoti.
an5.75:2.4: Ayaṃ bhikkhave dutiyo yodhājīvo santo saṃvijjamāno lokasmiṃ. 4.
an5.75:3.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave idh' ekacco yodhājīvo sahati rajaggaṃ sahati dhajaggaṃ,
an5.75:3.2: api ca kho ussādanaṃ yeva sutvā saṃsīdati visīdati na santhambhati na sakkoti saṃgāmaṃ otarituṃ.
an5.75:3.3: Evarūpo pi bhikkhave idh' ekacco yodhājīvo hoti.
an5.75:3.4: Ayaṃ bhikkhave tatiyo yodhājīvo santo saṃvijjamāno lokasmiṃ. 5.
an5.75:4.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave idh' ekacco yodhājīvo sahati rajaggaṃ sahati dhajaggaṃ sahati ussādanaṃ,
an5.75:4.2: api ca kho sampahāre haññati vyāpajjati.
an5.75:4.3: Evarūpo pi bhikkhave idh' ekacco yodhājīvo hoti.
an5.75:4.4: Ayaṃ bhikkhave catuttho yodhājīvo santo saṃvijjamāno lokasmiṃ. 6.
an5.75:5.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave idh' ekacco yodhājīvo sahati rajaggaṃ sahati dhajaggaṃ sahati ussādanaṃ sahati sampahāraṃ.
an5.75:5.2: So taṃ saṃgāmaṃ abhivijinitvā vijitasaṃgāmo tam eva saṃgāmasīsaṃ ajjhāvasati.
an5.75:5.3: Evarūpo pi bhikkhave idh' ekacco yodhājīvo hoti.
an5.75:5.4: Ayaṃ bhikkhave pañcamo yodhājīvo santo saṃvijamāno lokasmiṃ.
an5.75:5.5: Ime kho bhikkhave pañca yodhājīvā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ. 7.
an5.75:6.1: Evam eva kho bhikkhave pañc'ime yodhājīvūpamā puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā bhikkhūsu.
an5.75:6.3: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu rajaggaṃ yeva disvā saṃsīdati visīdati na santhambhati na sakkoti brahmacariyaṃ santānetuṃ,
an5.75:6.7: ‘amukasmiṃ nāma gāme vā nigame vā itthi vā kumārī vā abhirūpā dassanīyā pāsādikā paramāya vaṇṇapokkharatāya samannāgatā' ti.
an5.75:6.8: So taṃ sutvā saṃsīdati visīdati na santhambhati na sakkoti brahmacariyaṃ santānetuṃ,
an5.75:7.1: Seyyathā pi so bhikkhave yodhājīvo rajaggaṃ yeva disvā saṃsīdati visīdati na santhambhati na sakkoti saṃgāmaṃ otarituṃ,
an5.75:7.3: Evarūpo pi bhikkhave idh' ekacco puggalo hoti.
an5.75:7.4: Ayaṃ bhikkhave paṭhamo yodhājīvūpamo puggalo santo saṃvijjamāno bhikkhūsu. 9.
an5.75:8.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu sahati rajaggaṃ,
an5.75:8.2: api ca kho dhajaggaṃ yeva disvā saṃsīdati visīdati na santhambhati na sakkoti brahmacariyaṃ santānetuṃ,
an5.75:8.5: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu na h'eva kho suṇāti
an5.75:8.6: ‘amukasmiṃ nāma gāme vā nigame vā itthi vā kumārī vā abhirūpā dassanīyā pāsādikā paramāya vaṇṇapokkharatāya samannāgatā' ti,
an5.75:8.7: api ca kho samaṃ passati itthiṃ vā kumāriṃ vā abhirūpaṃ dassanīyaṃ pāsādikaṃ paramāya vaṇṇapokkharatāya samannāgataṃ.
an5.75:8.8: So taṃ disvā saṃsīdati visīdati na santhambhati na sakkoti brahmacariyaṃ santānetuṃ,
an5.75:9.1: Seyyathā pi so bhikkhave yodhājīvo sahati rajaggaṃ,
an5.75:9.2: api ca kho dhajaggaṃ yeva disvā saṃsīdati visīdati na santhambhati na sakkoti saṃgāmaṃ otarituṃ,
an5.75:9.4: Evarūpo pi bhikkhave idh' ekacco puggalo hoti.
an5.75:9.5: Ayaṃ bhikkhave dutiyo yodhājīvūpamo puggalo santo saṃvijjamāno bhikkhūsu. 10.
an5.75:10.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu sahati rajaggaṃ sahati dhajaggaṃ,
an5.75:10.2: api ca kho ussādanaṃ yeva sutvā saṃsīdati visīdati na santhambhati na sakkoti brahmacariyaṃ santānetuṃ,
an5.75:10.5: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhuṃ araññagataṃ vā rukkhamūlagataṃ vā suññāgāragataṃ vā mātugāmo upasaṅkamitvā ūhasati ullapati ujjhaggeti uppaṇḍeti.
an5.75:10.6: So mātugāmena ūhasiyamāno ullapiyamāno ujjhaggiyamāno uppaṇḍiyamāno saṃsīdati visīdati na santhambhati na sakkoti brahmacariyaṃ santānetuṃ,
an5.75:11.1: Seyyathā pi so bhikkhave yodhājīvo sahati rajaggaṃ sahati dhajaggaṃ,
an5.75:11.2: api ca kho ussādanaṃ yeva sutvā saṃsīdati visīdati na santhambhati na sakkoti saṃgāmaṃ otarituṃ,
an5.75:11.4: Evarūpo pi bhikkhave idh' ekacco puggalo hoti.
an5.75:11.5: Ayaṃ bhikkhave tatiyo yodhājīvūpamo puggalo santo saṃvijjamāno bhikkhūsu. 11.
an5.75:12.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu sahati rajaggaṃ sahati dhajaggaṃ sahati ussādanaṃ,
an5.75:12.2: api ca kho sampahāre haññati vyāpajjati.
an5.75:12.4: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhuṃ araññagataṃ vā rukkhamūlagataṃ vā suññāgāragataṃ vā mātugāmo upasaṅkamitvā abhinisīdati abhinipajjati ajjhottharati.
an5.75:12.5: So mātugāmena abhinisīdiyamāno abhinipajjiyamāno ajjhotthariyamāno sikkhaṃ appaccakkhāya dubbalyaṃ anāvikatvā methunaṃ dhammaṃ paṭisevati.
an5.75:13.1: Seyyathā pi so bhikkhave yodhājīvo sahati rajaggaṃ sahati dhajaggaṃ sahati ussādanaṃ api ca kho sampahāre haññati vyāpajjati,
an5.75:13.3: Evarūpo pi bhikkhave idh' ekacco puggalo hoti.
an5.75:13.4: Ayaṃ bhikkhave catuttho yodhājīvūpamo puggalo santo saṃvijjamāno bhikkhūsu. 12.
an5.75:14.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu sahati rajaggaṃ sahati dhajaggaṃ sahati ussādanaṃ sahati sampahāraṃ. So taṃ saṃgāmaṃ abhivijinitvā vijitasaṃgāmo tam eva saṃgāmasīsaṃ ajjhāvasati.
an5.75:14.3: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhuṃ araññagataṃ vā rukkhamūlagataṃ vā suññāgāragataṃ vā mātugāmo upasaṅkamitvā abhinisīdati abhinipajjati ajjhottharati.
an5.75:14.4: So mātugāmena abhinisīdiyamāno abhinipajjiyamāno ajjhotthariyamāno viniveṭhetvā vinimocetvā yenakāmaṃ pakkamati.
an5.75:14.5: So vivittaṃ senāsanaṃ bhajati araññaṃ rukkhamūlaṃ pabbataṃ kandaraṃ girigūhaṃ susānaṃ vanapatthaṃ abbhokāsaṃ palālapuñjaṃ.
an5.75:15.1: So araññagato vā rukkhamūlagato vā suññāgāragato vā nisīdati pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā.
an5.75:15.2: So abhijjhaṃ loke pahāya vigatābhijjhena cetasā viharati, abhijjhāya cittaṃ parisodheti,
an5.75:15.3: vyāpādapadosaṃ pahāya avyāpannacitto viharati sabbapāṇabhūtahitānukampī vyāpādapadosā cittaṃ parisodheti,
an5.75:15.4: thīnamiddhaṃ pahāya vigatathīnamiddho viharati ālokasaññī sato sampajāno thīnamiddhā cittaṃ parisodheti,
an5.75:15.5: uddhaccakukkuccaṃ pahāya anuddhato viharati ajjhattaṃ vūpasantacitto uddhaccakukkuccā cittaṃ parisodheti,
an5.75:15.6: vicikicchaṃ pahāya tiṇṇavicikiccho viharati akathaṃkathī kusalesu dhammesu vicikicchāya cittaṃ parisodheti.
an5.75:15.7: So ime pañca nīvaraṇe pahāya cetaso upakkilese paññāya dubbalīkaraṇe
an5.75:16.1: So evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigatūpakkilese mudubhūte kammaniye thite ānejjappatte āsavānaṃ khayañāṇāya cittaṃ abhininnāmeti.
an5.75:16.2: So ‘idaṃ dukkhan' ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, ‘ayaṃ dukkhasamudayo' ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, ‘ayaṃ dukkhanirodho' ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, ‘ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā' ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti,
an5.75:16.3: ‘ime āsavā' ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, ‘ayaṃ āsavasamudayo' ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, ‘ayaṃ āsavanirodho' ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, ‘ayaṃ āsavanirodhagāminī paṭipadā' ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
an5.75:16.4: Tassa evaṃ jānato evaṃ passato kāmāsavā pi cittaṃ vimuccati, bhavāsavā pi cittaṃ vimuccati, avijjāsavā pi cittaṃ vimuccati,
an5.75:16.6: ‘khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyā' ti pajānāti.
an5.75:17.1: Seyyathā pi so bhikkhave yodhājīvo sahati rajaggaṃ sahati dhajaggaṃ sahati ussādanaṃ sahati sampahāraṃ. So taṃ saṃgāmaṃ abhivijinitvā vijitasaṃgāmo tam eva saṃgāmasisaṃ ajjhāvasati,
an5.75:17.3: Evarūpo pi bhikkhave idh' ekacco puggalo hoti.
an5.75:17.4: Ayaṃ bhikkhave pañcamo yodhājīvūpamo puggalo santo saṃvijjamāno bhikkhūsu.
an5.75:17.5: Ime kho bhikkhave pañca yodhājīvūpamā puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā bhikkhūsū
